subject.title: fix(matrix): reverse-proxy path support for Matrix homeserver URLs

question: Should Matrix homeserver URL path components be treated as meaningful reverse-proxy base paths for OpenClaw helper requests on upgrade?
rationale: The code path and proof look sound, but changing a persisted homeserver URL's path from ignored to meaningful is a compatibility-sensitive Matrix channel contract that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept Path-Valued Homeserver Semantics
options.body: Matrix owners explicitly accept that configured homeserver path components should be preserved for helper requests, letting this PR proceed through normal exact-head checks.

options.title: Require Broader Matrix Proof
options.body: Maintainers ask for a redacted send/receive, media, or directory round trip through the path-prefixed proxy before accepting the channel-level risk.

options.title: Pause For Config Contract Redesign
options.body: If path-bearing homeserver URLs need different product semantics, pause this PR until the desired Matrix config behavior is documented and implemented.

recommendation.title: Accept Path-Valued Homeserver Semantics
recommendation.body: Matrix owners explicitly accept that configured homeserver path components should be preserved for helper requests, letting this PR proceed through normal exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md lists Matrix in gumadeiras' area and history shows ownership of adjacent Matrix transport and network behavior.
